outcome.answer: The closest match is [2], which uses structured supervised fine-tuning with an interpretable slot-filling template and then DPO refinement to detect polarization in social media text. It is not exactly “political leaning” spotting, but it is a two-stage method for polarization detection in posts and explicitly combines slot-based training with preference optimization. [1] is also related, but it improves political stance detection by adding user-context profiles rather than using preference optimization.
